<!--
An epic is a container, not a task. It holds tickets and states what they add up
to; it is never worked on directly. If nothing would be lost by deleting this
issue and keeping its tickets, it should not exist.

A checklist inside an epic is a checklist, not twenty tickets. Split out only
what someone could pick up on its own.

Language: English - this is project steering. The names of vault files, notes
and coined terms stay German. See method.json.
-->
